# We act for Halberd Industrial Holdings, Inc. (Buyer) on its proposed $84,000,000 acquisition of all outstanding shares of Brightwater Sensor Systems, Inc. unde…

## How many shares of common stock are outstanding?

SPA Section 3.4 represents 6,250,000 shares of Common Stock outstanding, but the cap table shows 6,412,500 shares of Common Stock outstanding — a 162,500-share discrepancy. [F1]

## How many stock options are outstanding?

The SPA states options over 450,000 shares are outstanding under the 2021 Plan; the cap table shows 610,000 options outstanding. [F2]

## Are there any warrants or other rights to acquire the Company's shares?

The cap table discloses a warrant held by Lakeside Venture Debt LLC to purchase 85,000 shares of Common Stock, which Section 3.4's no-warrants representation omits. [F3]

## Does the Series A have protective provisions or consent rights over a sale of the Company?

The share sale is a Deemed Liquidation Event and requires the written consent of holders of at least 60% of the Series A Preferred Stock under Article V, Section 4. [F4]

## What liquidation preference do the Series A Preferred holders have?

The Series A carries a 1.5x participating liquidation preference: 1,200,000 shares x $5.00 x 1.5 = $9,000,000 paid ahead of common, after which Series A also participates. [F5] [F1]

## Do the charter or bylaws restrict transfers of the Company's stock?

Article VI gives the Company a right of first refusal over any stock transfer; it must be waived by board resolution approved by the Series A director, or the transfer is void. [F6]

## What happens to the Norrland supply agreement on a change of control?

Norrland, the sole qualified source of MEMS die, may terminate the Supply Agreement on 30 days' notice given within 90 days after notice of the change of control (Section 12.2). [F7]

## Does the Norrland supply agreement contain a minimum purchase commitment?

The Norrland agreement imposes a $2,400,000 annual minimum purchase commitment with a take-or-pay Shortfall Payment. [F8]

## What rights does Arcadia have if the Company is acquired?

Arcadia's MSA defines 'Competitor of Customer' to expressly include Halberd Industrial Holdings and its Affiliates; on closing Arcadia may terminate immediately and claw back unearned Prepaid Fees (up to $1,150,000). [F9]

## Does the Arcadia MSA require consent to a change of control?

Arcadia's prior written consent is required for any change of control of Brightwater (Section 13.1; threshold 40% of voting equity). [F10]

## Can the Cobalt license be assigned or transferred in a merger or change of control?

The Cobalt license cannot transfer by merger or change of control without Cobalt's prior written consent; a violating transfer is void and lets Cobalt terminate immediately — and the Licensed Software is the core of HydroSense Cloud. [F11]

## Does a sale of the Tenant's stock require the landlord's consent under the lease?

The Corrigan Park lease treats a transfer of more than 49% of Tenant's voting stock as an assignment requiring Landlord consent (not to be unreasonably withheld). [F12]

## When does the lease expire, and is a renewal option still exercisable?

The option to extend had to be exercised by September 30, 2026; absent evidence of a notice, it has lapsed and the lease expires June 30, 2027. [F13]

## What change in control payment is the CEO entitled to?

Daniel Okafor is owed a single-trigger Change in Control Payment of $770,000 (2.0x his $385,000 base salary), payable whether or not his employment ends. [F14]

## What happens to the CEO's equity awards on a change in control, and is there a 280G provision?

All of the CEO's unvested equity accelerates on the change in control (single trigger, 100%), and there is no 280G cutback. [F15]

## Is the CEO's non-compete enforceable?

The 24-month North America non-compete is governed by California law and is likely void under Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code s.16600; Buyer should not price in its protection. [F16]

## Are third-party consents a condition to closing under the SPA?

Under SPA Section 6.5 obtaining third-party consents is expressly not a condition to Closing; Buyer should add a closing condition for the Norrland, Arcadia and Cobalt consents. [F17]

## Which consents does the disclosure schedule list?

Schedule 3.6 lists only the Corrigan Park lease as requiring consent and omits the Norrland, Arcadia and Cobalt change-of-control consents. [F18]

## What cap and survival period apply to indemnification under the SPA?

Section 8.4 caps Sellers' liability at 10% of the Purchase Price ($8,400,000) including for Fundamental Representations such as capitalization; fundamental reps should be capped at the Purchase Price with longer survival. [F19]
